scene: You reach the mansion's breezy rooftop dock where city transports wait.
picture: Flat side view. Along the rooftop dock floor, the silver-haired grandmother in pink tracksuit stands left-of-centre holding her small white dog on a lead. On the far left, a striped gondola drone hovers with open gate. Centre waits a brass spiral tram on corkscrew tracks. On the far right sits an idling hover metro pod.
shown: a striped drone gondola hovering gently with its passenger gate swung open, far left
a brass spiral tram perched on corkscrew rails with doors slid wide, centre
a sleek hover metro pod idling beside the landing platform edge, far right
